sources: Wages & amortisation: club accounts / Swiss Ramble / SportsPro 2024/25 filings where available (not Capology-only)
Adjusted revenue: football turnover + profit/(loss) on player trading (SCR-style denominator)
Agent fees: FA Football Agent Fees disclosure (2 Feb 2024 – 3 Feb 2025)
Player stack: Capology/FBref name weights scaled to accounts wage & amort totals
Coaching staff: carved from accounts wage bill (label only — not an extra cost on top)
disclaimer: SCR-style estimate. Capology first-team fixed wages alone understate real wage bills (e.g. Brentford Capology ~£42m vs accounts ~£131m). Viral “89%” for Brentford is usually (wages+amort)÷(revenue+player sales) without agent fees; official SCR also includes agents. Accounts staff costs include some non-first-team roles, so this can sit slightly above pure SCR.
